**Sell Mahomes. Now.**

Mahomes is 31, elite-tier QB, value 27.3. In a 1QB league, that value is structurally capped. You cannot start two QBs. You already have Jaxson Dart at 23 with a 76% snap share in year one. Dart is your 2028 QB1 candidate. Mahomes is redundant capital sitting at peak price in a format that doesn't reward QB depth.

**Why they say yes:**

Mahomes is a name. In a 12-team league, at least two or three managers are one injury away from QB panic. The trade deadline creates urgency on their side, not yours. You are the calm seller; they are the nervous buyer. Price accordingly.
